**Corpse seed juice** is a drink in *Fallout 76*.

Corpse seed juice is a drink made from corpse seeds that increases maximum AP by 10 and restores a small amount of HP and thirst at the cost of minor rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Corpse seeds (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Corpse seeds | | Corpse seed juice (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up corpse seeds for the first time.
